candidates.name: OGC PUCK Protocol
verified_facts: OGC PUCK defines a protocol for RS232 and Ethernet-connected instruments and supports automatic retrieval of instrument metadata and related information.
PUCK can help identify, configure and operate instruments but augments rather than replaces existing instrument command sets.
semantic_limits: Device identification, driver retrieval or configuration metadata is not a calibration certificate and does not establish the accuracy of a terrain observation.

candidates.name: OGC Sensor Planning Service
verified_facts: OGC Sensor Planning Service defines interfaces to query sensor capabilities and to submit, reserve, update, cancel and monitor sensor planning requests.
SPS supports tasking workflow and access to information about data collected by requested tasks.
semantic_limits: A successful task request or task status is not the resulting observation and does not certify measurement quality, calibration or vertical accuracy.
